title: ZalithOptimized
description: A performance-focused Minecraft Java modpack optimized for Zalith Launcher, PojavLauncher, DroidBridge Launcher, Mojo Launcher, and other Android Java launchers.
body:
# ZalithOptimized

**ZalithOptimized** is a performance-focused Minecraft Java modpack made for Android launchers like **Zalith Launcher, PojavLauncher, DroidBridge Launcher, Mojo Launcher**, and other mobile Java launchers.

This modpack is built to make Minecraft Java run smoother on phones and tablets by improving FPS, reducing lag, lowering RAM usage, and making gameplay feel more stable on Android devices.

## Features

- Better FPS on Android devices
- Lower RAM usage
- Faster loading times
- Smoother gameplay
- Mobile-friendly optimization settings
- Built for Zalith Launcher and other Android Java launchers
- Works great for mid-range and high-end phones
- Lightweight and focused on performance

## Supported Launchers

- Zalith Launcher
- PojavLauncher
- DroidBridge Launcher
- Mojo Launcher
- Other Android Java launchers

## Recommended Devices

For the best experience, use a device with:

- **4GB RAM minimum**
- **6GB+ RAM recommended**
- Snapdragon, MediaTek Dimensity, or similar modern Android CPU
- Android 10 or newer recommended

## About

ZalithOptimized is made for players who want a cleaner and smoother Minecraft Java experience on Android without needing a heavy modpack.

**Built for Android. Optimized for Minecraft Java.**
